paras.t: A straight shot down MoPac from Rosedale, with free covered parking when you get here. Casey Morgan D.C. finds what's causing your pain before he treats it.
West End Chiropractic is at 1611 W. 5th St., on the ground floor of 5th Street Commons, just off MoPac. From Rosedale, it's a straight shot south.

sections.name: Section / Insurance
sections.title: Work at Ascension Seton? You're covered here.

paras.t: If you work for Ascension or Seton, whether you're a nurse, doctor, or on staff, you're likely on Ascension SmartHealth, and West End is in-network.
We're also in-network with BCBS, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Humana, Ambetter, Medicare, and more. Send us your insurance info when you book and we'll look into your coverage before your first visit.
